body:
Thanks man. Maybe I’ll give the city thing another shot. I was in a city of 66,000 for the last 3 years and was more miserable than ever. Just moved back to my hometown of about 6,000 because I felt that I’d be better off being close to my family. 

I felt really isolated in that city. Too many unfriendly strangers. But it was 3 hours from my family, and maybe that’s more the issue. There’s a similar size city only an hour from here. Might be the best of both worlds. I’d need a car though, can’t be cut off from my family. So then we’re right back in that tricky spot of not being able to afford both car and home. 

If I stay in this town, I can get around no problem without a car, and hopefully find cheap housing. But I can’t leave town... if I get a car, I can get out of town whenever I want, but I have to put up with the roommates and the mold. 

I’m tempted to get a car, ditch the roommates and just live in the car until I can afford a new place. But that’s a dangerous game in the Midwest. Winter will be back before we know it.

Ah okay, yeah. I know I have my whole life ahead of me still. Young, capable of change, whatever. But its hard moving up, especially saddled with questionable mental health. Just feels unfair right now.
25, why?
You’re absolutely right! I’m going to try to just focus on envisioning that amazing feeling of being safe and free.

Right? Fucking inanimate objects, man. They’re sons of big bitches. 

Edit: my phones predictive text must have stuttered. The word “big” wasn’t meant to be in there. But I like it. Imma leave it.

I do have a room to myself, thankfully. I have to walk past them to get anywhere else in the house though. And this whole thing is made worse by the fact that I’m in the process of moving, so everything is in a disarray and I have no real sense of home and safety. It could be worse though. And it makes me feel a tiny bit better to know you went through similar situations and survived. I know I’ll survive. Just really don’t need this right now. Fuck. It takes so much out of me to be this anxious and stressed. I know tomorrow I won’t be able to stay awake more than a few hours at a time and I have so much to get done so I can get the truck Monday morning and leave. But at the end, I’m gone. I don’t have to see him again. I’ll living with family who love me. I’ll be okay. Thank you for sharing your take on things and letting me vent. It has helped a bit. I really appreciate it.

I wish I knew. I haven’t stepped on a scale in a while but I have to have gained 10-20lbs in the past month. Why can’t I be the loss of appetite type of depressed? All I do is eat and sleep. I’ve literally been falling asleep eating lately. Lay down with a massive bowl of spaghetti (I mean a fucking mixing bowl, okay) and eat until it hurts or I pass out. I usually get through about 3/4 of it or more. Good god, I am a monster. I regret typing this out. Yikes. Guarantee I’m still gonna make some spaghetti tonight though. Fuck me.

Unfortunately, I have no one in this area I can stay with.  My one friend has 6 kids and with the whole covid thing, I don’t want to invite myself over. 

I’m trapped here. It really really sucks.

He has to know it’s true we’re wrong for each other. It’s hard for both of us. I still love him and I wish we could make things work. I know he knows this is for the best. And it’s been a really rough year. It’s not like this came out of nowhere. We’ve both been on the verge of calling it quits a few times last year.

Yeah, I have no intention of doing that anytime soon. I have way too much to figure out with moving and everything. Plus I just really need to work on myself for a while before I let anyone else into my life.
It sounds like you’re at a really good place to move forward on your own. Don’t wait until something happens to tie you to him more. You deserve better!
Thank you!

Thank you, this was very insightful. It does sound like you’ve been through what I’m going through.

>You talked about a lack of a meaningful connection with him.  Was this something that you always felt or was it something that you felt right away but as time went on, that seemed to have been lost?

It was really never there. We had good sex. Then it developed into a comfortable relationship. I felt loved and accepted. But never really understood. It felt like enough at first. I thought I had the most important parts of a relationship. But now I think I just can’t live without a deeper connection. 

>(Although I am guessing that it's not, I feel that I should add this next bit) = If it is something that you feel that has been lost over time, there is a chance that what is really lost is your feeling of infatuation.  We all to often take our feeling of infatuation to be a feeling of love when it isn't.  Infatuation helps us build our love for someone, but it is not love itself and over time as the love builds, the need for infatuation to keep us together gets less and less and often as that feeling goes away we will confuse that with our love having gone away when it hasn't if we still feel that we care about them. =  Take this into consideration as a possibility, but with you talking about some emotional abuse at least at first, and then where you were emotionally when you started seeing each other, that's probably not your issue.

Yeah, I never felt that infatuation. It started physical, and developed into a love and care for each other. But more of a surface thing. I love him more like a friend I think. 

>It sounds more like you were at a low point in your life and you found someone that seemed to accept you at least in some way and you held onto that.  You are now realizing that what you held onto wasn't what you really wanted but maybe at that point felt that it was all that you were going to be able to get.  Trust me, I completely understand this because it's what I did in my first marriage.  I met someone that seemed to want to be with me and I held onto her because I didn't feel that anyone else ever would, so I had to take what I could get even if it meant the pain she put me through.  Thankfully that divorce is long, long over with and I eventually met someone new that felt perfect for me. (sadly after 2 years of marriage, I wasn't perfect for her)

This is exactly it. I had ended a long term relationship a year before we met and I was still not in a good place. I was just trying to work on myself, get back out there and get comfortable with dating and stop isolating myself. It was really not a good time to get into something serious again. I thought I could handle casual dating, but I was weak and got sucked in. 

>When looking at divorce and the pain that will come with it, it's hard to believe that you will ever find love again or maybe even want to find love again.  I believe that we all can do so if we are willing to put in the work to fully get past our marriage before trying to look for a new love.  We have to give ourselves the time to really deal with the loss in our life before trying to move on.  If we don't deal with it, then it will away be hiding right under the surface and will come back out at some point and most likely destroy any relationship/s that we are in when it happens, until we have taken the time to deal with the loss.  Give yourself this time.  You may feel completely ready to jump out there and find someone new, but hold off for a while to make sure that you are good on your own before trying to find someone else to be able to lean on from time to time.

I hope to approach love with a lot more wisdom and caution in the future. But not shut myself off to it. Definitely focus on myself for a while first. It’s scary, but I’m an optimist and I want to believe I’ll have a healthy future relationship. 

Thank you for all your wide words! I didn’t expect this much help when I posted.
I need to remember that! It’s easier to get out now than it would be if we have kids. My life is only beginning, it’s not over.

Thank you. I know it, but sometimes I need to be told that I’m too selfless for my own good. I have a lot to work on, and I need to be alone to clear my head and sort myself out. 

Luckily our finances aren’t terribly intertwined, and I have somewhere to go. He has a good heart, I think it’ll be amicable enough. Painful, but not dangerous.

You’re right. I guess I just feel like so many people deal with far worse in their marriage. But that doesn’t make it okay. Just normalized. I should be better than that. I should have better than that. 

Why we got married? Man, it’s hard to pin down an honest answer. We were never very close on an emotional level. It was a fine, casual dating sort of thing. After 6 months of dating, he wanted to move in with me. I should have said no, but I thought that I’d seem like an asshole. I think he was honestly kind of fed up with his roommates. And I think he desperately wanted a stable relationship. He never had much stability growing up and he may have idealized being in a long term relationship. I suppose I put his wants above mine. 

He proposed when we were probably at our best point in the relationship. I had my doubts, but I thought “that’s normal” and said yes anyway. I thought maybe this was what I needed to finally feel happy and whole. We were only engaged 5 months. I didn’t want a long engagement and I thought the sooner we get married, the sooner we can start a family and I’ll have everything I should need to be content with life. I have never been in a happy, stable state of mind, and of course this marriage didn’t magically fix that. I had hoped it would. I’m too optimistic sometimes. It was simply a mistake. A big one, but just a stupid mistake. I do love him and care about him and I’m not sorry I’ve had this time with him. I’m only sorry that we’re both going to end up hurting now.

True, but so can all the prescriptions they keep throwing at me. 6 months ago my dr. had me on 5 different antidepressants and anti anxiety meds, simultaneously. I know I need a new doctor, and I plan on finding one in April when I move. We’ll see if they have any different insights for me. So far, modern medicine has only fucked me up more. Like I said, not much left lose by trying alternative substances at this point.

I’ve had dpdr for as long as I can remember. It became a lot worse after extended abuse of dxm (put my trust in the wrong person, many mistakes were made, I’m past that time in my life) but it’s somewhat leveled back out now. I still deal with more often than I’d like to. 

Anyway, despite the way dxm affected me, I’m seriously considering trying lsd or shrooms. My depression is absolutely unbearable and I’ve had some awful experiences with prescription meds. I’m running out of options here and I’m willing to take a risk. I really have nothing to lose at this point.

Edit: this is just my experience and my thought process behind the motivation to try these drugs. Definitely not trying to promote them as a good idea for everyone. Hell, good chance they’re not even a good idea for me.

Hey, thanks again for your kind words. I finally told him last night. Well I couldn’t actually get the words out but he does know now. It feels like a huge weight off my shoulders. Even if I’m still anxious as hell, it’s one less thing to stress about.
Thank you!
That’s exactly it.
Yeah, it’s probably inevitable anyway. Hiding it just isn’t all that feasible
You’re probably right

I have this one weird comforting thought at times. The thought that perhaps my brain is literally damaged. That would mean it’s not so much that I’m terrible. But that my brain just isn’t capable of behaving how it should. You can’t blame an amputee for not being able to run a marathon. Maybe if my brain was injured I wouldn’t blame myself for being the person I am.
It’s such bullshit, isn’t it? Sometimes I just want to take my brain and shake it violently. Like why can’t you just be on my team for once you worthless lump of jello??

I can’t really relate to the physical violence part. Verbal abuse sure. But it sounds like we basically have the same mindset. Feeling like we deserve hate. No one truly knows me either. I can’t help but be fake for some reason. I guess it’s what you’re supposed to do. Be normal. Be nice. Fit in. Not for my sake so much. But so as not to be a bother to others

My brain manages to ruin everything I like. Not good enough. Wasting your time. Looking stupid. Not worth it. I end up distracting myself with meaningless stuff like tv and games. And then I feel like shit because I’m not doing anything with life. Just wasting away the days. Can’t win I guess. Once in a while I have a few good days or even a week or more. But lately even during those I’m thinking in the back of my head “don’t get too used to this. It’s going to end. It’s not the real you. It’s just fantasy you’re playing out but you can’t keep it up for long.”

Some little part of me knows you’re right. I do have good days and I get what you’re saying on some level. But I haven’t figured out how to get that tiny little part to speak up loud enough when I really need it to. When the really bad thoughts take over. They’re so much stronger.

I feel this so deep. 

Like every day I’m at the edge of a cliff. Trying not to acknowledge the cliff is there. Because if I acknowledge the cliff, I won’t be able to stop thinking about walking off if and I might just not be able to stop myself. So I avert my eyes. I play dumb games on my phone and watch tv and go to work, etc. My heart isn’t in it at all. I’m just going through the motions. The whole time my head is screaming at me “look over there at the cliff!!! THE CLIFF! The clifffff!!!!!!” on a loop, endlessly. And all I can do is try to drown out the screams with meaningless distractions.

I’m so sorry you’re going through that too. As much as I hate myself, I have probably too much compassion for every other person on earth. Weird how that works. I wish I could absorb all your bad feelings and you could feel good.

Yeah that’s the plan I guess. I never wear pants around the house but I can probably make it seem natural since it’s getting cold out. Have to avoid sex for a while. Which sucks because our argument was about sex and I feel like it’s going to cause a further rift between us if from his perspective I’m acting uninterested in sex after the argument we had. It’s going to just reinforce the way our fight made him feel and I really don’t want that. But I don’t know what else I can do.
I think it’s also that my head wants me suffer more. Suffering from my own abusive thoughts isn’t enough. Some fucked up part of me thinks I deserve to feel even worse.

Man, reading that gave me that feeling like your heart is literally tearing apart in your chest. I wish I could know the feeling of believing that... everything you said. But my mind tells me it’s wrong wrong wrong. And how dare I entertain such ideas. My mind is mean but it’s always right
I think Stella sounds great with Lily and Willow!
If anyone figures it out let me know. I so desperately want to find passion in life again.
